hints.title: Multi-Source Level-By-Level Traversal
hints.text: All water cells must have height 0; initialize the search front with all water cells simultaneously.

hints.title: Breadth-First Expansion
hints.text: For each cell expanded from queue, unassigned adjacent cells receive height = current height + 1.

hints.title: Optimal Peak Guarantees
hints.text: Multi-source BFS ensures every cell gets maximum allowable height while satisfying adjacent difference <= 1.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Computing distance from each land cell to all water cells individually takes O(m^2 * n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Multi-source breadth-first search visits every cell once in O(m * n) time and O(m * n) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate utilizes multi-source BFS starting from all water cells simultaneously.
